market_outlook.short_term: Markets face headwinds from oil-driven inflation, weak ADP data, and geopolitical risk. Expect continued equity volatility with energy outperforming. Yen intervention risk adds FX noise. Fed on hold but hawkish bias likely given inflation. 1-3 month: range-bound equities, rising yields, strong energy.
market_outlook.long_term: AI capex cycle and grid infrastructure buildout support tech/energy leadership. Commodity supply tightness (copper, cocoa, cocoa) creates structural inflation floor. India and select EM benefit from capital rotation. UK housing and global construction face multi-year adjustment. Crypto institutional adoption accelerates. 6-12 month: selective equity upside, commodity strength, EM divergence.
